title: What NavLab Simulates in Urban GNSS
dek: A project note on satellite geometry, 3DMA, atmospheric delay, and synthetic ionospheric disturbances.
body: NavLab is an interactive browser laboratory for examining how satellite geometry, buildings, measurement error, and atmospheric delay affect a GNSS position solution.

The project compares weighted least squares, 3D mapping-aided GNSS, and factor graph optimization. Its typhoon and travelling-ionospheric-disturbance scenarios are synthetic educational models, not official space-weather products.
